title: Character Survival and Death Log
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session event=downed
| stats count as times_downed, sum(eval(if(outcome="died",1,0))) as deaths by character
| sort - times_downed
description: Logs how often each character has been knocked out or killed, the war stories a long campaign accumulates.
value: A downed-and-died tally is both a fun record and a signal of encounters that may be too deadly.
implementation: Ingest downed events into `index=personal`; count knockouts and deaths per character.
visualization: Bar chart of times downed and deaths by character.
grandmaExplanation: It logs how often each hero has been knocked out or killed, the war stories of a long campaign.
